title: Exploring the role of microfinance institutions in promoting financial sustainability and alleviating poverty in Ghana
core_idea: Using Mix Market data for 11 Ghanaian microfinance institutions over 2000–2019 and multivariate analysis, the study examines which institutional and outreach-related factors (e.g., depth/breadth of outreach, dependency ratio, cost per borrower, operational expenditures, loan size, capital structure) are associated with financial viability and how MFIs relate to financial depth and poverty alleviation.
tldr: Analyzes 2000–2019 data for 11 Ghanaian MFIs with multivariate methods to identify institutional and outreach factors linked to MFI financial viability and their relation to financial depth and poverty alleviation (no results reported).
